entries.Original: Requirements for achievement: Take no damage, use all 6 magic elements, use all 3 melee types, kill all 3 clones in act3 and finish faster than 6min 30s.
entries.Translated: 完成要求：不受伤害，使用全部 6 种魔法元素，使用全部 3 种近战类型，在 act3 中杀死全部 3 个克隆人，完成速度超过 6 分 30 秒。
超硬化！（多次全屏 + 击退）

entries.Original: Spawns hands. Focus left hand first.
entries.Translated: 生成大手。优先攻击左手。

entries.Original: Prepare to use Excuviation to remove debuff
entries.Translated: 准备使用蜕皮移除减益

entries.Original: will drain all your MP, kill it fast!
entries.Translated: 将吸取你所有MP，尽快击杀它！

entries.Original: will do multiple raidwides, kill it fast!
entries.Translated: 将进行多次全屏攻击，尽快击杀它！

entries.Original: You were doomed! Cleanse it with Exuviation.
entries.Translated: 你被死亡宣告了！使用蜕皮除垢。

entries.Original: will cast Throttle on you which needs to be cleansed with Excuviation.
entries.Translated: 会对你施加特罗特尔，需要用清洁术清理。

entries.Original: It will also spawn two hands which need to be killed asap. Focus the left hand first because it will drain all your MP.
entries.Translated: 它还会产生两只需要被杀死的手。先集中注意力在左手上，因为它会耗尽你所有的 MP。

entries.Original: Pyretic, stop everything! Dodge the AOE after it runs out.
entries.Translated: 热病，停止一切行动！效果结束后躲避AOE。

entries.Original: For this act Exuviation and Diamondback are mandatory.
entries.Translated: 对于本法案，Exutation 和 Diamondback 是强制性的。

entries.Original: Bringing Flying Sardine, lightning and wind spells is higly recommended.
entries.Translated: 强烈推荐携带飞沙丁鱼、闪电和风系魔法。

entries.Original: will spawn upto 4 waves of adds which are weak to fire.
entries.Translated: 将产生多达 4 波附加物，这些附加物在火力方面较弱。

entries.Original: A way to quickly heal yourself to full is mandatory and a ranged fire ability such as Mustard Bomb and Flying Sardine for interrupts are highly recommended.
entries.Translated: 快速完全治愈自己的方法是强制性的，强烈推荐使用远程火力能力，如芥子气炸弹和飞沙丁鱼来打断。

entries.Original: will spawn Bombs and Magitek Explosives throughout the fight. Use Snort to push away Bombs from Magitek Explosives and bait Fireballs away from them.
entries.Translated: 将在整个战斗过程中产生炸弹和魔法爆炸物。使用喷嚏将炸弹从魔法爆炸物上推开，并将火球引开。

entries.Original: Meanwhile destroy the explosives as soon as possible, because they will blow up on their own after about 35s.
entries.Translated: 与此同时，尽快销毁炸药，因为它们在大约 35 秒后就会自动爆炸。

entries.Original: If any magitek explosive detonates you will be wiped. The explosives are vulnerable against water abilities and strong against fire attacks.
entries.Translated: 如果任何 Magitek 炸药爆炸，你就会被消灭。炸药对水能力很脆弱，对火攻击很强。

entries.Original: Electrocution on you! Cleanse it with Exuviation.
entries.Translated: 你身上有感电！用蜕皮解除。

entries.Original: will cast Raw Instinct, which causes all his hits to crit. Use Eerie Soundwave to dispel it.
entries.Translated: 将播放《原始本能》，这会导致他所有的热门歌曲都受到评论。使用 Eerie Soundwave 来消除这种影响。

entries.Original: is weak against earth and strong against lightning attacks.
Windburn on you! Cleanse it with Exuviation.
entries.Translated: 你身上有裂伤！用蜕皮解除。

entries.Original: will cast Alternate Plumage, which makes him almost immune to damage.
entries.Translated: 将施加替代羽毛，这使他几乎对伤害免疫。

entries.Original: Use Eerie Soundwave to dispel it. Caber Toss must be interrupted or you will wipe.
entries.Translated: 使用 Eerie Soundwave 来消除它。必须打断 Caber Toss，否则你会被擦掉。

entries.Original: Additionally Exuviation and earth spells are recommended for act 2.
entries.Translated: 此外，推荐在第二幕中使用排泄和土系咒语。

entries.Original:
Bait the Meteor to the edge of the arena!
Use Loom to escape or Diamondback to survive.
entries.Translated:
将黄道陨石引到场地边缘！
使用隐遁逃脱或超硬化存活。

entries.Original: You were doomed! Cleanse it with Exuviation or finish the act fast.
entries.Translated: 你被注定了！用蜕皮解除或尽快结束此幕。

entries.Original: will switch between magic and physical reflects. Spend attention to that so you don't accidently kill yourself.
entries.Translated: 会在魔法和物理反射之间切换。请注意这一点，以免不小心害死自己。

entries.Original: As soon as he starts casting Web go to the edge to bait Meteor, then use Loom to escape.
entries.Translated: 一旦他开始施展网络，就会去边缘引诱流星，然后使用织布机逃跑。

entries.Original: You can start the Final Sting combination at about 50% health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated: 你可以在健康状况还剩约 50% 的情况下开始 Final Sting 组合。(Offguard->Bristle->Moon Flute->Final Sting)

entries.Original: ! Use physical attacks except fire aspected.
entries.Translated: ！使用物理攻击，但不要用火属性。

entries.Original: He will also spawn adds that need to be dealed with swiftly, since they will spam raidwides.
entries.Translated: 他还会补充说需要迅速处理，因为他们将发布广泛的垃圾邮件突袭。

entries.Original: The adds are immune against magic and fire attacks.
entries.Translated: 这些附加物对魔法和火焰攻击具有免疫力。

entries.Original: will reflect all physical damage in act 1, all magic damage in act 2 and switch between both in act 3.
entries.Translated: 将反映第一幕中的所有物理伤害，第二幕中的所有魔法伤害，并在第三幕中在两者之间切换。

entries.Original: Loom, Exuviation and Diamondback are recommended.
entries.Translated: 推荐使用织布机、纺织机和钻石背。

entries.Original: In act 3 can start the Final Sting combination at about 50% health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated: 在第三幕中，可以在体力剩余约 50% 的情况下开始 Final Sting 组合。(Offguard->Bristle->Moon Flute->Final Sting)

entries.Original: Requirements for achievement: Take no damage, use no healing, use all 6 magic elements, use all 3 melee types and finish faster than 7min 15s
entries.Translated: 完成要求：不受伤害，不使用治疗，使用所有 6 种魔法元素，使用所有 3 种近战类型，完成速度超过 7 分 15 秒

entries.Original:
fast or wipe!
Use ranged physical attacks.
entries.Translated:
尽快否则团灭！
使用远程物理攻击。

entries.Original: spawns two adds when casting Boneshaker. These should be a priority or they will explode and wipe you. To kill them without touching the electric field use a ranged physical attack such as Fire Angon.
entries.Translated: 施展碎骨者时会增加两个幼体。这些应该是优先考虑的，否则它们会爆炸并消灭你。要在不触碰电场的情况下杀死它们，可以使用远程物理攻击，例如火焰安贡。

entries.Original: casts Silence which should be interrupted.
entries.Translated: 投射应该被打断的沉默。

entries.Original: Condensed Libra puts a debuff on you. Use Diamondback to survive thefollowing attack.
entries.Translated: 浓缩天秤座会对你造成负面影响。使用钻石背来生存下一次攻击。

entries.Original: Alternatively you can cleanse the debuff with Exuviation.
entries.Translated: 或者，你也可以使用 Exuviation 来清理 Debuff。

entries.Original: is immune to magic, the viking is immune to physical attacks.
entries.Translated: 维京人对魔法免疫，对物理攻击免疫。

entries.Original: For the 2nd act Diamondback is highly recommended.
entries.Translated: 对于第二幕，强烈推荐《钻石背》。

entries.Original: For the 3rd act a ranged physical spell such as Fire Angon is highly recommended.
entries.Translated: 对于第三幕，强烈推荐使用范围广泛的物理魔法，如火焰安贡。

entries.Original: will use Ecliptic Meteor. Use Diamondback to survive it.
entries.Translated: 将使用黄道流星。使用钻石背来生存。

entries.Original: You can start the Final Sting combination at about 40% health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated: 您可以在体力还剩约 40% 的情况下开始 Final Sting 组合。(Offguard->Bristle->Moon Flute->Final Sting)

entries.Original: Wipe if Grenade is not killed yet, otherwise Raidwide
entries.Translated: 若榴弹怪尚未被击杀则团灭，否则全屏

entries.Original: spawns grenades and gas bombs during the fight. Just as in act 1 the grenades must be killed in one hit each or they will wipe you.
entries.Translated: 在战斗中产生手榴弹和毒气弹。就像在第一幕中一样，手榴弹必须一击必杀，否则它们会将你消灭。

entries.Original: Use Sticky Tongue to pull Gas Bombs to the boss so they interrupt the enrage.
entries.Translated: 使用粘舌把毒气弹拉到老板那里，这样它们就会中断爆发。

entries.Original: The first act is easy. Kill the grenades in one hit each or they will wipe you. They got 543 HP.
entries.Translated: 第一个动作很简单。一次性干掉所有手榴弹，否则它们就会消灭你。它们的 HP 是 543。

entries.Original: If you gear is bad consider using 1000 Needles. For the 2nd act you should bring Sticky Tongue.
entries.Translated: 如果你的装备不好，可以考虑使用 1000 根针。在第二幕中，你应该带上黏舌头。

entries.Original: In the 2nd act you can start the Final Sting combination at about 50% health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated: 在第二幕中，你可以在体力还剩约 50% 的情况下开始最后的刺击组合。(出其不意->Bristle->Moon Flute->最后的刺击)

entries.Original: Interrupt The Rams Keeper with Flying Sardine.
entries.Translated: 打断《公羊守护者与飞翔的沙丁鱼》

entries.Original: You can start the Final Sting combination at about 50% health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting).
entries.Translated: 你可以在健康状况还剩 50% 左右时开始 Final Sting 组合。(Offguard->Bristle->Moon Flute->Final Sting)

entries.Original: The boss will sometimes spawn an imp during the fight.
entries.Translated: 老板有时会在战斗中产生一个小恶魔。

entries.Original: The imps are weak to fire spells and strong against ice. Interrupt Void Blizzard with Flying Sardine.
entries.Translated: 小恶魔对施法能力较弱，但对冰的抵抗力强。用飞沙丁鱼打断虚空暴风雪。

entries.Original: The first act is fairly easy. Interrupt the Void Blizzards with Flying Sardine and most of the danger is gone.
entries.Translated: 第一个行动相当简单。用飞沙丁鱼打断虚空暴风雪，大部分危险就消失了。

entries.Original: This act is act 1+2 combined with tentacles on top.
entries.Translated: 这个动作是 1+2 动作与顶部的触手相结合。

entries.Original: The Final Sting combo (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting) makes this act including the achievement much easier.
entries.Translated: 最后一击组合 (Off-guard->Bristle->Moon Flute->Final Sting) 使得这个动作，包括成就，变得更加容易。

entries.Original: Requirement for achievement: Don't kill any tentacles in this act
entries.Translated: 成就要求：这一幕中不击杀任何触手

entries.Original: is weak to fire. Interrupt Imp Song.
entries.Translated: 弱火属性。打断河童之歌。

entries.Original: Diamondback and Flying Sardine are essential for this stage.
entries.Translated: 响尾蛇和飞沙丁鱼对这个阶段至关重要。

entries.Original: The Final Sting combo (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting) can make act 3 including the achievement much easier. Ultros in act 2 and 3 is weak to fire.
entries.Translated: 最后一击组合 (Off-guard->Bristle->Moon Flute->Final Sting) 可以让第三幕 (包括成就) 变得容易得多。第二幕和第三幕中的 Ultros 很难发射。

entries.Original: Requirement for the achievement: Don't kill any tentacles in act 3
entries.Translated: 完成要求：不要在第三幕中杀死任何触手

entries.Original: Cast Ink Jet on boss to get blinded!
entries.Translated: 对Boss施放喷墨来致盲自己！

entries.Original: Boss will reflect all magic damage!
Same as first act, but this time the boss will cast a gaze from all directions.
entries.Translated: 与第一幕相同，但这次老板会从四面八方投来目光。

entries.Original: The easiest counter for this is to blind yourself by casting Ink Jet on the boss after it casted Schizocarps.
entries.Translated: 对付这种情况最简单的办法就是在施放了精神分裂果实之后，再对老板施放喷墨。

entries.Original: The Final Sting combo window opens at around 75% health. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated: Final Sting 组合视窗在 75% 左右的健康状态下打开。(Off-guard->Bristle->Moon Flute->Final Sting)

entries.Original: At the start of the fight Rebekkah will cast Reflect. This will reflect all magic damage back to you.
entries.Translated: 在战斗开始时，丽贝卡会施展反射咒。这会将所有魔法伤害反射回你身上。

entries.Original: Useful skills: Sharpened Knife, Flying Sardine, Ink Jet (Act 2), Exuviation (Act 2), potentially a Final Sting combo. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated: 有用技能：锋利的刀、飞翔的沙丁鱼、喷墨 (第二幕)、释放 (第二幕)，可能是最终刺杀组合。(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)

entries.Original: Same as last stage. Make the manticores run to the kegs and their attacks will make them blow up. Their attacks will also do friendly fire damage to each other.
entries.Translated: 和上一阶段一样。让蝎尾狮跑到桶边，它们的攻击会让桶爆炸。它们的攻击也会对彼此造成友好的火力伤害。

entries.Original: The Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be used to kill manticores.
entries.Translated: 公羊之声和超声波组合可以用来杀死蝎尾狮。

entries.Original: Make the manticores run to the kegs and their attacks will make them blow up. They take 2500 damage per keg explosion.
entries.Translated: 让蝎尾狮冲向桶子，它们的攻击会让桶子爆炸。它们每桶爆炸会造成 2500 点伤害。

entries.Original: is weak to lightning spells. During the fight he will spawn one of each claws as known from act 1.
entries.Translated: 对闪电魔法抵抗力较弱。在战斗中，他会像第一幕中所描述的那样，每次释放一只爪子。

entries.Original: If available use the Ram's Voice + Ultravibration combo for instant kill.
entries.Translated: 如果可用，请使用公羊之声 + 超声波组合来实现瞬间杀伤。

entries.Original: counters magical attacks, the other claw counters physical attacks.
entries.Translated: 抵挡魔法攻击，另一只爪子抵挡物理攻击。

entries.Original: If you have healing spells you can just tank the counter damage and kill them however you like anyway.
entries.Translated: 如果你有治疗咒语，你可以直接施放反伤害，然后随心所欲地杀死它们。

entries.Original: All opponents in this stage are weak to lightning. The Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be used in act 2.
entries.Translated: 在这个阶段，所有对手都对闪电免疫。公羊之声和超声波组合可以在第二幕中使用。

entries.Original: will spawn a cyclops a few seconds into the fight. Make sure to kill it before it reaches you. After that you can just slowly take down the boss.
entries.Translated: 会在战斗开始几秒钟内产生一个独眼巨人。确保在它靠近你之前杀死它。之后你就可以慢慢地解决掉这个 boss 了。

entries.Original: Use Diamondback to survive the 1111 Tonze Swing. Alternatively you can try the Final Sting combo when he drops to about 75% health. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated: 使用 Diamondback 在 1111 Tonze Swing 中生存下来。或者，当他的血量下降到约 75% 时，你可以尝试 Final Sting 组合。(预防->Bristle->Moon Flute->Final Sting)

entries.Original: The cyclops are very slow, but will instantly kill you, if they catch you. Kite them or kill them with the self-destruct combo. (Toad Oil->Bristle->Moonflute->Swiftcast->Self-destruct)
entries.Translated: 独眼巨人速度很慢，但如果他们抓住你，会立即杀死你。要么用风筝杀死他们，要么用自毁组合杀死他们。(蟾蜍油->布里斯托->月笛->快速传输->自毁)

entries.Original: If you don't use the self-destruct combo in act 1, you can bring the Final Sting combo for act 2. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting) Diamondback is highly recommended in act 2.
entries.Translated: 如果你在第一幕中没有使用自毁组合，你可以在第二幕中使用最终刺杀组合。(预防->Bristle->Moonflute->最终刺杀) 强烈推荐在第二幕中使用 Diamondback 组合。

entries.Original: For this stage Flying Sardine and Acorn Bomb are highly recommended. Use Flying Sardine to interrupt High Voltage. Use Acorn Bomb to put Shabtis to sleep until their buff runs out.
entries.Translated: 在这个阶段，强烈推荐使用飞沙丁鱼和橡子炸弹。使用飞沙丁鱼来中断高压。使用橡子炸弹来让沙布蒂斯睡觉，直到他们的 buff 耗尽。

entries.Original: Same as first act, but the slimes will apply heavy to you. Use Loom to get out of line of sight as soon as Final Song gets casted.
entries.Translated: 和第一幕一样，但黏液会对你造成很大影响。一旦《最终之歌》开始演出，就使用织布机离开人们的视线。

entries.Original: These slimes start casting Final Song after death. While Final Song is not deadly, it does heavy damage and applies silence to you. Take cover!
entries.Translated: 这些史莱姆在死后开始施展最终之歌。虽然最终之歌并不致命，但它会造成严重伤害，并对你施加沉默。找掩护！

entries.Original: For act 2 the spell Loom is strongly recommended. The slimes are strong against blunt melee damage such as J Kick.
entries.Translated: 对于第二幕，强烈推荐使用 “Loom” 咒语。这种黏液对钝器近战伤害具有很强的抵抗力，例如 “J Kick”。

entries.Original: Harmless raidwide unless you failed to kill succubus in time
entries.Translated: 无害的全屏攻击，除非你未能及时击杀梦魔

entries.Original: will cast various AOEs and summons adds. Interrupt the adds with Flying Sardine and kill them fast. If the add is still alive during the next Black Sabbath, you will be wiped.
entries.Translated: 将释放各种 AOE 和召唤增益。使用飞沙丁鱼中断增益并迅速杀死它们。如果增益在下个黑色安息日仍然存活，你将被抹杀。

entries.Original: The first act is trivial, almost anything will work. For act 2 having Flying Sardine is recommended.
entries.Translated: 第一幕微不足道，几乎任何情节都能奏效。对于第二幕，推荐使用《飞翔的沙丁鱼》。

entries.Original: Calls Roselets. Prepare Ice Spikes if available.
entries.Translated: 召唤玫瑰幼虫。如果有冰棘，请准备好。

entries.Original: when he casts Inflammable Fumes. Use Ice Spikes to instantly kill roselets once they become aggressive.
entries.Translated: 当他施放易燃烟雾时。一旦玫瑰花变得具有攻击性，就立即使用冰刺杀死它们。

entries.Original: is weak against water and strong against earth spells.
entries.Translated: 弱水属性，抗土属性魔法。

entries.Original: For this stage Ice Spikes and Bomb Toss are recommended spells. Use Ice Spikes to instantly kill roselets once they become aggressive. Hydnora in act 2 is weak against water and strong against earth spells.
entries.Translated: 对于这个阶段，推荐使用冰刺和炸弹投掷法术。一旦蔷薇变得具有攻击性，就使用冰刺立即杀死它们。第二幕中的海德诺拉对水的抵抗力弱，对土系法术的抵抗力强。

entries.Original: Same as last act, but this time there are 4 bombs. Pull them to the middle with Sticky Tongue and attack them with any AOE to keep them interrupted. They are weak against wind and strong against fire.
entries.Translated: 和上次表演一样，但这次有 4 枚炸弹。用粘舌把它们拉到中间，然后用任何 AOE 攻击它们以阻止它们。它们对风的抵抗力弱，但对火的抵抗力强。

entries.Original: These bombs start self-destruction on combat start. Pull them together with Sticky Tongue and attack them with anything to interrupt them. They are weak against wind and strong against fire.
entries.Translated: 这些炸弹在战斗开始时就会自爆。用粘舌把它们拉到一起，然后用任何可以打断它们的东西攻击它们。它们对风的抵抗力弱，对火的抵抗力强。

entries.Original: will cast King's Will during the fight. Interrupt it with Flying Sardine or he will become stronger each time. After 3 casts he starts using the interruptible enrage Black Nebula.
entries.Translated: 将在战斗中施展王者意志。用飞沙丁鱼打断它，否则他每次都会变得更强。施展三次后，他开始使用可打断的黑色星云。

entries.Original: summons a total of 6 adds during the fight, one of each element. Healer mimikry can be helpful if you have trouble surviving.
entries.Translated: 在战斗中总共需要 6 个元素，每个元素各一个。如果你遇到生存困难，治疗师的模仿技能可能会有所帮助。

entries.Original: Clever activation of cherry bombs will freeze the
entries.Translated: 巧妙地激活樱桃炸弹将使其冻结

entries.Original: . Interrupt its burst skill or wipe. The
entries.Translated: 中断其爆发技能或擦除。

entries.Original: For this stage the spell Flying Sardine to interrupt the Progenitrix in act 2 is highly recommended. Hit the Cherry Bomb from a safe distance with anything but fire damage to set of a chain reaction to win this act.
entries.Translated: 在这个阶段，强烈推荐使用 “飞翔的沙丁鱼” 咒语来打断第二幕中的始祖龙。从安全距离击中樱桃炸弹，除了火焰伤害，其他任何方式都可以，以建立连锁反应来赢得这一幕。

entries.Original: Hit the Cherry Bomb from a safe distance to win this act.
entries.Translated: 从安全距离击中爆弹仔以通过本幕。

entries.Original: Pull or push the Lava Slimes to the towers and then hit the slimes from a distance to set off the explosions. The towers create a damage pulse every 12s and a deadly explosion when they die. Take cover.
entries.Translated: 将熔岩史莱姆拉或推到塔上，然后从远处击中史莱姆引发爆炸。塔每 12 秒就会产生一次伤害脉冲，当它们死亡时会发生致命爆炸。寻找掩护。

entries.Original: Pull or push the Lava Slimes to the Ice Sprites and then hit the slimes from a distance to set of the explosions.
entries.Translated: 将熔岩史莱姆拉或推向冰雪精灵，然后从远处击中史莱姆以引发爆炸。

entries.Original: For this stage the spells Sticky Tongue and Snort are recommended. Use them to pull or push Slimes close to Ice Sprites. Then hit the slime from a distance with anything but fire spells to set of an explosion.
entries.Translated: 在这个阶段，建议使用粘稠舌头和鼻息咒。使用它们将史莱姆拉近或推近冰雪精灵。然后从远处用除火焰咒之外的任何咒语攻击史莱姆，以引发爆炸。

entries.Original: from a safe distance to win this act.
entries.Translated: 从安全距离以通过本幕。

entries.Original: Kill mandragoras last incase you need to get blinded again.
entries.Translated: 最后再击杀曼德拉草，以防你需要再次被致盲。

entries.Original: The eyes are weak to lightning spells.
Get blinded by the Teary Twirl AOE from the mandragoras. Blindness makes you immune to all the gaze attacks. The eyes in act 2 are weak to lightning damage.
entries.Translated: 被曼德拉草的催泪旋风 AOE 致盲。失明使你对所有目光攻击免疫。第二幕中的眼睛对闪电伤害抵抗力较弱。

entries.Original: These turtles have very high defenses. Bring 1000 Needles or Doom to defeat them. Alternatively you can remove their buff with Eerie Soundwave.
entries.Translated: 这些海龟的防御力非常高。带上 1000 根针或毁灭来击败它们。或者，你也可以使用 Eerie Soundwave 来解除它们的 BUFF。

entries.Original: is weak to lightning spells. During the fight he will spawn 6 beetles. If available you CAN use the Ram's Voice + Ultravibration combo for the instant kill.
entries.Translated: 对闪电魔法抵抗力较弱。在战斗中，他会产下 6 只甲虫。如果可以的话，你可以使用公羊之声 + 超级振动组合来瞬间杀死它们。

entries.Original: is weak against lightning spells and can be frozen.
entries.Translated: 弱雷属性法术，且可以被冻结。

entries.Original: Trivial act. Enemies here are weak to lightning and fire. In Act 2 the Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be useful. Flying Sardine for interrupts can be beneficial.
entries.Translated: 琐碎的戏码。这里的敌人对闪电和火焰抵抗力弱。在第二幕中，公羊的声音和超声波组合可能会有用。用飞沙丁鱼来打断可能会有帮助。

entries.Original: Bats are weak to lightning. The wolf is weak to fire.
is weak against water based spells. Earth based spells are useless against
entries.Translated: 对水系魔法效果较弱。土系魔法对水系魔法无效。

entries.Original: . Flying Sardine is recommended to interrupt raidwide.
entries.Translated: 飞沙丁鱼建议中断全面突袭。

entries.Original: Gelato is weak to fire spells. Flan is weak to lightning spells. Licorice is weak to water spells.
entries.Translated: Gelato 对火系魔法抵抗力弱。Flan 对闪电系魔法抵抗力弱。甘草对水系魔法抵抗力弱。

entries.Original: To beat this stage in a timely manner, you should have at least one spell of each element. (Water, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth and Wind)
entries.Translated: 为了及时通过这个阶段，你需要至少掌握每种元素的一个法术。(水、火、冰、闪电、土和风)

entries.Original: For this act: Pudding is weak to wind spells. Marshmallow is weak to ice spells. Bavarois is weak to earth spells.
entries.Translated: 对于这个行为：布丁对风系魔法无能为力。棉花糖对冰系魔法无能为力。巴伐利亚对土系魔法无能为力。

entries.Original: This stage is trivial. Use whatever skills you have to defeat these opponents.
entries.Translated: 这个阶段微不足道。使用你所拥有的一切技能来击败这些对手。

entries.Original: Interact with the actor on the green circle

entries.Translated: 全面突袭 + 应用瘫痪

entries.Original: Kill the MyconidPiece inside the water puddles to solve the mechanic correctly
entries.Translated: 在水坑中杀死 MyconidPiece，以正确解决机械问题

entries.Original: Avoid hitting LamiaPieces with the bait, while hitting the CyclopsPieces
entries.Translated: 避免用诱饵攻击 LamiaPieces，同时攻击 CyclopsPieces

entries.Original: Baited petrify cone, will damage buff lamias and petrify cyclops on hit. Can also cast rotating versions. YOU WILL INSTANTLY DIE IF YOU GET PETRIFIED BY THIS
entries.Translated: 被诱饵石化锥体，击中时会伤害布法蛇和独眼巨人。还可以施放旋转版本。如果你被这个石化，你会立即死亡。

entries.Original: Lamia: Will attempt to revive any dead lamias, interrupt this cast.
entries.Translated: 拉米亚：将试图唤醒任何死去的拉米亚，中断这次施法。

entries.Original: Cyclops: Casts PB aoes covering the entire arena when spawned, petrify them to stop it. These will also instantly die upon taking any damage while petrified
entries.Translated: 独眼巨人：在产卵时释放覆盖整个竞技场的 PBao，将它们石化以阻止它。这些 Ao 也会在石化过程中受到任何伤害后立即死亡。

entries.Original: Bait far away on one side of the map!
entries.Translated: 在地图的一侧远远地抛出诱饵！

entries.Original: Hit any slime with the bait!
entries.Translated: 用诱饵击中任何史莱姆！

entries.Original: Hit the orange slime with the bait!
Hint the purple slime with the bait!
Fight kill priority: CyclopsPiece -> Slimes (whichever one we are not killing with bait) -> small slimes / boss
entries.Translated: 战斗击杀优先：独眼巨人——>史莱姆 (任何我们没有用诱饵杀死的东西)——>小史莱姆/老板

entries.Original: When the boss crushes a slime it will absorb its element and have additional effects after a Gigantic Rage cast ends. Lightning club will leave a tower under you (stay) after a Gigantic Rage, fire club will leave an aoe under you (move) after a Gigantic Rage
entries.Translated: 当 boss 击碎一个史莱姆时，它会吸收其元素，并在巨型愤怒释放结束后产生额外效果。闪电部会在你下方留下一座塔 (保持不动)，火部会在你下方留下一个 Aoe(移动)。

entries.Original: Smashing Stamp: Line aoe in front, there is a smaller red rectangle in the aoe near the boss that will kill a slime in it and absorb its element. Avoid hitting a slime with the same element as the club, or the slime will grow large instead of dying
entries.Translated: 粉碎印记：在前方的草地上，靠近 boss 的草地上有一个较小的红色矩形，它会杀死其中的史莱姆并吸收其元素。避免击中与球杆元素相同的史莱姆，否则史莱姆会变大而不是死亡。

entries.Original: Rapture: Interrupt - If there are 2 slimes, have the boss crush the one with the opposite element of the club, then interrupt the other one
entries.Translated: 狂喜：中断——如果有两个史莱姆，让老板用俱乐部的相反元素粉碎其中一个，然后中断另一个

entries.Original: Camaraderie: Interrupt or it will heal the boss 5% max HP
entries.Translated: 伙伴情谊：打断它，否则它会治愈老板 5% 最大 HP

entries.Original: Raidwide - Pet cover does not work
Drop the bait at a corner of the map!
entries.Translated: 把诱饵放在地图的一角！

entries.Original: Atomic Ray: Heavy raidwide damage - Pet cover will not take damage for you
entries.Translated: 原子射线：严重的全面空袭伤害——宠物保护不会对你造成伤害

entries.Original: DrakePiece: Uses Blaze Spikes which will reflect damage when attacked - This can be dispelled
entries.Translated: Drake Piece:使用 Blaze Spikes，当受到攻击时会反射伤害——这可以被解除

entries.Original: BarbmolePiece: Casts Needles Out, which will make it reflect with a stacking bleed when attacked.
entries.Translated: BarbmolePiece:把针扔出去，这会使针在受到攻击时产生堆积出血反射。

entries.Original: AbaddonPiece: Eats MorphoPiece and gains regen stacks. Will not gain regen if MorphoPiece is low HP when eaten - Don't kill until all MorphoPiece are dead
entries.Translated: AbaddonPiece:吞噬 MorphPiece 并获得再生堆栈。如果 MorphPiece 在吞噬时 HP 较低，则不会获得再生堆栈——在所有 MorphPiece 死亡之前不要杀戮

entries.Original: MorphoPiece: Applies WitsEnd upon reaching 16 stacks will cause Confused debuff. Killing MorphoPiece will cause confuse debuff as well, must be eaten by AbaddonPiece
entries.Translated: MorphoPiece:当达到 16 个堆栈时应用 WitsEnd 将导致混乱的 Debuff。杀死 MorphoPiece 也会导致混乱的 Debuff，必须被 AbaddonPiece 吞噬
全面攻击 + 施加毒素

entries.Original: Toxic Tantrum: Raidwide + poison, can be esuna’d
entries.Translated: 有毒的愤怒：全面突袭 + 毒药，可能会导致失败

entries.Original: Fight kill priority: BombPiece -> DeepeyePiece -> LightSprite -> boss
entries.Translated: 战斗击杀优先级:BombPiece -> DeepeyePiece -> LightSprite -> boss

entries.Original: Sprite: Will cast a cone toward where it's facing when it dies, aim it toward the boss to reveal it
entries.Translated: Sprite:将一个圆锥体投向它死亡时所面对的方向，将其对准 Boss 以揭示真相

entries.Translated: 巴伐利亚碎片将在被击杀并产生 9 个水坑时发动击退攻击。

entries.Translated: 战斗击杀订单优先级:SaplingPiece -> BikoPiece -> DimitPiece/SlugPiece -> TreantPiece

entries.Translated: 战斗击杀订单优先级:GrenadePiece(紫色)->任何其他添加->Boss

entries.Original: Killing ice bombs near fire puddles will get rid of them
entries.Translated: 在火坑附近杀死冰弹可以消除它们。

entries.Translated: 冰坑会在你站在里面时产生好几层冻结效果，一旦你达到 8 层，你就会被冻结在原地。

entries.Original: This boss has an enrage - When you have killed both golems, it will turn into a heart which you have to kill within 20.0 seconds
entries.Translated: 这个 BOSS 有怒火——当你杀死两个魔像后，它会变成一颗心脏，你必须在 20.0 秒内杀死它。

entries.Original: Fight kill order priority: QueenHawkPiece (purple) -> Boss (red)
entries.Translated: 战斗击杀订单优先级:QueenHawk Piece(紫色)->Boss(红色)

entries.Original: You can use the FloralTrap pull-in to have the boss kill the QueenHawkPiece if you stand behind it during the mechanic
entries.Translated: 如果你在机关操作期间站在女王鹰棋子后面，就可以使用 “花之陷阱” 拉入让老板杀死它。

entries.Translated: 打断混淆咒语，否则你将陷入 12 秒的混乱状态，并且很可能会死亡——如果你足够快地杀死 BOSS，这个咒语可以跳过。
避免与鸡蛋热门盒相交！

entries.Original: When adds spawn kill order is the following: PulletPiece (purple) -> CockerelPiece -> Boss
entries.Translated: 添加生物时，杀死顺序如下:PulletPiece(紫色)-> CockerlPiece-> Boss

entries.Original: The ymir will take reduced damage until its shell is broken. When its shell is broken it will move to the closest shell and enter it. Stun and bind can help delay the ymir from reaching a shell.
entries.Translated: 伊米尔会受到较小的伤害，直到它的外壳破裂。当它的外壳破裂时，它会移动到最近的外壳并进入其中。眩晕和束缚可以帮助延迟伊米尔到达外壳的时间。

entries.Original: Paralyzing Spikes: Buff on sahagin that inflicts paralysis if hit. Casted at the start of the fight and whenever ymir gets a new shell
entries.Translated: 麻痹尖刺：施加在萨哈金身上的增强效果，一旦命中就会造成麻痹。在战斗开始时以及每当伊米尔获得新的弹壳时都会施加。

entries.Original: Interrupt the Dreadwash spell or use your pet to take the damage down.
entries.Translated: 停止恐惧洗礼咒语或使用宠物减轻伤害。

entries.Original: Bone bishops will periodically spawn, these will drop an orb when killed that the boss will absorb when it casts Doubling. Up to 5 orbs can be absorbed, avoid having 5+ orbs accumulate or else mechanics will be undodgable
entries.Translated: 骨主教会周期性地产生，这些主教在被杀死时会掉落一个宝珠，BOSS 在施展 Doubling 时会吸收这个宝珠。最多可以吸收 5 个宝珠，避免累积超过 5 个宝珠，否则机制将无法避免。

entries.Original: Run to donut orb to pop early!

entries.Original: After the raidwide, spawns 3x circle orbs and 3x donut orbs. Getting hit will petrify the player
entries.Translated: 在全面突袭后，将产生 3 个圆形球体和 3 个甜甜圈球体。被击中将使玩家石化。

entries.Original: Orbs explode either on reaching the edge of the arena or the player running into it. Pop donuts early if you want
entries.Translated: 球体要么在到达竞技场边缘时爆炸，要么在运动员冲进去时爆炸。如果你想早点吃甜甜圈，那就来吧。
